prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1070; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the scene, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a rear-end impact on a roadway in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 was operating a sedan that was stopped in the right lane of traffic when the vehicle was struck from behind by a pickup truck operated by Driver 2. Driver 2 stated that he was following too closely and did not notice the sedan slow until it was too late to stop. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back and was assisted by emergency medical personnel on scene. Driver 1 declined transport at that time. Both vehicles sustained rear and front damage and were driven from the roadway after documentation. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation. Witness statements were obtained from a nearby motorist who confirmed the sequence of events.
